"""Conservative closed-loop target navigation policy."""


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Use safety gating, confidence hysteresis, and bounded directional memory."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan_direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    scan_hold = max(0, int(memory.get("scan_hold", 0)))

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_conf = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_conf = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety_conf = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])

    if safety_conf < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory.update(state="STOPPED", scan_hold=0)
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = visible and target_conf >= 0.55 and identity_conf >= 0.60
    if not confirmed:
        if state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY", "REACQUIRE"} or lost_steps:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            if lost_steps <= 1:
                return "STOP", 0.92, memory

        if scan_hold:
            memory["scan_hold"] = scan_hold - 1
        else:
            scan_direction = (
                "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan_direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
            )
            memory["scan_direction"] = scan_direction
            memory["scan_hold"] = 2
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        return scan_direction, 0.75, memory

    memory["scan_hold"] = 0
    if track_age < 2:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    if (
        distance == "near"
        and abs(float(observation["heading_error"])) <= 15.0
        and identity_conf >= 0.80
    ):
        memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
        return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    if abs(bearing) > 12.0:
        preferred = "VEER_LEFT" if bearing < 0 else "VEER_RIGHT"
        if preferred == "VEER_LEFT" and observation["corridor_left"]:
            return preferred, 0.90, memory
        if preferred == "VEER_RIGHT" and observation["corridor_right"]:
            return preferred, 0.90, memory

    if observation["corridor_center"]:
        return "FORWARD", 0.90, memory
    if bearing < 0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.82, memory
    if bearing >= 0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.82, memory
    if observation["corridor_left"]:
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.78, memory
    if observation["corridor_right"]:
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.78, memory

    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    return "STOP", 0.98, memory


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
